product.name: Linkers Cx People Counter
product.description: A people counting system that measures foot traffic, customer demographics, and behavior inside and outside retail stores to analyze store performance.

product.name: Linkers Ox Predictive Maintenance
product.description: A system that monitors operational metrics to enable predictive maintenance and improve business productivity through configurable triggers and scenarios.
